title: How the widget store loads
subtitle: Three steps from request to cached row

diagram.source: Request->WidgetStore->Cache
diagram.caption: A read goes through the store, which consults the cache before the database.

steps.title: The entry point
steps.narration:
Every read enters through `get`, which is the **only** public accessor.

It never touches the database directly.

steps.title: The cache miss path
steps.narration: On a miss the store falls through to the loader, then writes the result back.

excerpts.code:
row = self._loader.load(widget_id)
    self._cache.put(widget_id, row)
    return row

def load(self, widget_id):
    return self._db.query(WIDGET_BY_ID, widget_id)

steps.title: Where invalidation happens
steps.narration: Writes evict the entry rather than updating it in place.
